_note: Curated by claude-main. 8 genuine TTS services from 73 candidates. Dropped: orbisapi 'Brand Voice'/voice-analysis (not TTS), STT (->speech-to-text), ElevenLabs Music/Sound/Video-to-Music (->music/sound-effects), agentwonderland business APIs, x402 Helper demos, LLM/markdown/deepfake junk. ElevenLabs idx 20 = the real /text-to-speech endpoint (idx 16 is speech-to-speech voice-changer; idx 58 is elevenlabs-music). resolved = agentcash exact prices.

entries.name: ElevenLabs
entries.description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech — natural, expressive voices with voice cloning and multilingual support.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM with JSON body {text}. The default Rachel voice (21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM) is baked into the URL — just send {text}, no voice_id needed.
usage.outputShape: Raw response body is binary audio (Content-Type: audio/mpeg, MP3). Not JSON — save the bytes directly to a .mp3 file.
quirks: Send ONLY {text}. The default Rachel voice id (21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM) is baked into the endpoint URL, so you do not pass a voice_id — re-verified working 2026-06-10 ($0.08, 200, 88KB MP3).
Response is binary MP3 audio, NOT JSON. Write the raw body to disk as .mp3.

body.text is the only required field; optional: model_id, language_code, voice_settings, seed, previous_text, next_text, apply_text_normalization. Optional query params: output_format, enable_logging.
To use a different voice, append a different ElevenLabs voice id as the last path segment in place of 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM (the bare base path without any voice id 404s).
Price is per-call ~$0.08 USDC on Base (maxAmountRequired 80000).
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM with a JSON body {"text":"...your text..."}. The default Rachel voice is built into the URL, so you do NOT need to supply a voice_id. Pay the x402 quote (~$0.08 USDC on Base). The response body is raw MP3 audio (Content-Type audio/mpeg) — write the bytes straight to a .mp3 file, do not parse as JSON. To use a different voice, replace the last path segment with another ElevenLabs voice id.

usage.outputShape: JSON: body.audio is a base64-encoded MP3 string; body.format = 'mp3'; body.model = 'tts-1'. Base64-decode body.audio and write it to a .mp3 file.
quirks: Body is just {text} — re-verified working 2026-06-10 ($0.01, 200). The OpenAI-native shape {model,input,voice} returns 400 'Provide text (string, required)'; use {text}.
Output is JSON, NOT raw bytes: the MP3 is base64 in body.audio. Decode it and save as .mp3 (do not save the JSON).
x402-paid ~$0.01 USDC on Base (also accepts Solana + Tempo).
usage.guide: POST https://x402-gateway-production.up.railway.app/api/tts/openai with a JSON body {"text":"...your text..."} and pay the ~$0.01 USDC x402 quote on Base. The response is JSON: base64-decode body.audio (an MP3) and write it to a .mp3 file. body.format is 'mp3'.

entries.name: Google TTS

usage.callShape: GET https://text-to-speech-x402-production.up.railway.app/api/speak?text=... (DEAD — 404). Task-summary alternate POST https://x402.orth.sh/google/tts {text} also DEAD — 404.
usage.outputShape: none — endpoint returns 404 error JSON, no audio result produced
quirks: Registry endpoint object and task summary disagree on the URL: registry says GET https://text-to-speech-x402-production.up.railway.app/api/speak, task summary says POST https://x402.orth.sh/google/tts. BOTH are dead.
Railway URL returns 404 {"status":"error","code":404,"message":"Application not found"} with header x-railway-fallback:true — the app is no longer deployed on Railway (root path also 404s).
orth.sh URL returns 404 {"error":"API not found","message":"Invalid API key/slug or API is not active"} — the proxy slug/route is dead/inactive.
Neither URL returns an HTTP 402 payment-required response, so there is no x402 payment surface at all — nothing to pay.
Original registry probe (2026-06-01) already recorded status 404, payable:false, blocked:true — confirmed still dead on retest 2026-06-09.
usage.guide: Do not call this service — it is dead. Both candidate URLs return hard 404s: the Railway host (text-to-speech-x402-production.up.railway.app) reports 'Application not found' with a railway fallback header meaning the app is undeployed, and the orth.sh proxy (x402.orth.sh/google/tts) reports 'API not found / Invalid API key/slug or API is not active'. Neither emits an HTTP 402, so there is no payment to make and no audio can be obtained. Mark this endpoint broken/removed; use a different TTS provider.

entries.name: Chatterbox
entries.description: Resemble AI Chatterbox — open-source expressive text-to-speech.

usage.callShape: POST https://stablevoice.dev/api/speech with JSON body {text, output:{publicUrl,uploadUrl|postUrl,postFields}, model?, voice?, language?, format?}
usage.outputShape: body.jobId, body.status (pending|queued|processing) — async; generated audio is delivered to the supplied output.publicUrl (poll that URL / the StableUpload object until ready)
quirks: SPEC URL MISMATCH: the real call url is https://stablevoice.dev/api/speech, NOT the registry summary's https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/chatterbox-tts. Use the stablevoice.dev url.

inputSchema requires BOTH `text` AND `output`. `output` is a StableUpload destination object requiring `publicUrl` (and presigned uploadUrl/postUrl/postFields) — you MUST provision a StableUpload output slot first; you cannot fabricate it.

Async: the response is just {jobId,status:pending|queued|processing,type,price}. The actual audio is written to your StableUpload output.publicUrl, not returned inline. Poll the StableUpload URL until the audio object exists.
Server returns 402 before validating the body, so a 402 pre-flight does NOT confirm the body is valid.
chatterbox-multilingual requires `language`. Custom voice cloning uses optional referenceAudioUrl (also a StableUpload URL); reference duration depends on model.
Not paid in QA: missing the required StableUpload output destination (managedResource/instructions null), so a paid call would risk losing $1 to a post-charge failure or undeliverable result.
usage.guide: First provision a StableUpload output slot (POST to StableUpload to get publicUrl + presigned upload fields). Then POST https://stablevoice.dev/api/speech with a JSON body {"text":"<short text>","model":"chatterbox-turbo","voice":"Lucy","format":"wav","output":{"publicUrl":...,"postUrl":...,"postFields":{...}}}, paying $1.00 USDC via x402 (Base eip155:8453 or Solana). The response returns {jobId,status} — it is async, so the generated audio is NOT inline; it lands at your output.publicUrl. Poll that StableUpload URL until the audio object is available, then download it. Use the real stablevoice.dev url, not the registry summary's xona-agent.com url.

entries.name: MiniMax
entries.description: MiniMax — multimodal AI including text-to-speech (also image and video generation).

usage.callShape: POST https://api.questflow.ai/x402/agent/qrn:agent:68ee3d375e8bc20f70eba02c with JSON body {"input": "<your message to the agent>"} (x402 USDC on Base). NOTE: registry method says GET but the 402 outputSchema mandates POST.

inputExample.input: Say this out loud: hello, how are you?

usage.outputShape: body.response (string) — per 402 outputSchema; NOT verified live (payment blocked).
quirks: URL CONFLICT: task-header CALL URL https://x402.orth.sh/minimax/v1/t2a returns 404 'Endpoint not found' (dead route) — do NOT use or pay it.
Working endpoint is the machine-spec URL https://api.questflow.ai/x402/agent/qrn:agent:68ee3d375e8bc20f70eba02c (questflow x402 agent wrapper).
Registry method=GET is WRONG: the live 402 outputSchema declares method=POST with required string body field 'input'. Call it as POST {"input": "..."}.
This is a generic questflow agent wrapper around MiniMax multimodal (TTS/image/video), not a dedicated /t2a endpoint — you steer it via natural-language 'input'.

PAYMENT NOT MADE: auto-mode safety classifier denied the real-money send because api.questflow.ai diverges from the user-specified CALL URL. Re-running requires explicit user authorization to pay the questflow URL.
usage.guide: Do not call the registry/task CALL URL x402.orth.sh/minimax/v1/t2a — it 404s. The real endpoint is POST https://api.questflow.ai/x402/agent/qrn:agent:68ee3d375e8bc20f70eba02c (pay via x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.10). Send a JSON body {"input": "<natural-language instruction, e.g. say this out loud: hello>"} even though the registry lists method GET. Read the agent's reply at body.response. This was NOT verified with a live paid call: the QA safety classifier blocked the payment because the working questflow URL differs from the user-specified CALL URL, so a human must authorize paying questflow before this can be confirmed.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/x-text-to-speech with JSON body {text} (x402, USDC on Base eip155:8453).
usage.outputShape: JSON: body.audio_url is a public CDN MP3 URL (DigitalOcean Spaces); body.metadata.voice_id (default 'Eve'). Download body.audio_url to get the audio.
quirks: Re-verified working 2026-06-10 ($0.01, 200). Output is JSON with a CDN URL (body.audio_url), NOT raw audio bytes — fetch that URL to get the .mp3.
Default voice is 'Eve' (body.metadata.voice_id). Body is just {text}.
x402-paid ~$0.01 USDC on Base.
usage.guide: POST https://api.xona-agent.com/base-main/audio/x-text-to-speech with a JSON body {"text":"...your text..."} and pay the ~$0.01 USDC x402 quote on Base. The response is JSON — the audio is at body.audio_url (a public CDN MP3 link); download that URL to retrieve the speech. Default voice is 'Eve'.

usage.callShape: POST https://x402.dellbot.win/tts-nano with JSON body {text} (UNVERIFIED — see quirks: task header gives a different URL)
usage.outputShape: unknown (not tested) — expected audio bytes (audio/mpeg or audio/wav) given TTS service

To proceed, a human must confirm the canonical endpoint URL. entries.name: Text-to-Speech (ElevenLabs)
entries.description: Synthesize speech from text with ElevenLabs (Flash v2.5 for real-time agents, Multilingual v2 / Eleven v3 for narration). Billed per input character; the exact price is quoted in the 402. Returns a hosted MP3 URL.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/audio/speech with body {input} (req), optional {model, voice, response_format, speed} -> synthesizes ElevenLabs TTS, returns JSON with a hosted MP3 URL + character count.
quirks: Dynamic pricing: billed per input character; the 402 quotes exact price (min $0.001, max $2.10). Short probe input quoted 1000 atomic units = $0.001 USDC on Base.

model must be a valid enum value: elevenlabs/flash-v2.5, elevenlabs/turbo-v2.5, elevenlabs/multilingual-v2, elevenlabs/v3. An invalid/OpenAI-style model (e.g. tts-1) returns HTTP 400 before the 402 (charge-then-error risk is low since validation happens pre-payment).
voice takes a voice alias (e.g. sarah, george) or a raw ElevenLabs voice_id; response_format one of mp3/opus/pcm/wav; optional speed 0.7-1.2.
Synchronous (no job id to poll) - synthesis typically <1s for Flash; returns the hosted MP3 URL directly in the response.
accepts only USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402 exact scheme.

entries.name: Sound Effects (ElevenLabs)
entries.description: Generate a cinematic sound effect from a text prompt (up to 22s). Flat price per generation.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/audio/sound-effects with body {text} (required); optional model, duration_seconds (0.5-22), prompt_influence (0-1), response_format (mp3/opus/pcm/wav) → returns JSON {url} pointing to a generated sound-effect audio clip (ElevenLabs).
quirks: Flat fixed price $0.0525 per generation (atomic 52501 USDC on Base eip155:8453) regardless of duration_seconds or format
Synchronous — returns the audio url directly in one response, no job id / no polling
duration_seconds is optional and bounded 0.5-22s; if omitted the model auto-selects length
prompt_influence is 0-1 (how strictly to follow the prompt)
x402 accepts present in both payment-required / x-payment-required headers and www-authenticate; body also restates price ($0.052500)

entries.name: Voices (free)
entries.description: List available ElevenLabs voices and their aliases for use with /v1/audio/speech. Free.

usage.callShape: GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/audio/voices (no params) -> returns a JSON list of available ElevenLabs voices, each with voice_id, name, category, labels (language/gender/age/accent/use_case), preview_url, and optional alias for use as the `voice` field on /v1/audio/speech.
quirks: Verified FREE (HTTP 200) 2026-06-24.
FREE endpoint: unpaid GET returns HTTP 200 with the full voices list, no x402 challenge, no payment header — never charges.
This is a helper/discovery endpoint for the paid /api/v1/audio/speech TTS endpoint, not a standalone TTS generator.
Response shape is {object:'list', endpoint:'/v1/audio/speech', note, data:[...]}; pass a voice's `alias` (if present) or `voice_id` as the `voice` field to /v1/audio/speech.
Cloudflare-cached (cache-control max-age=300), so the voice list may be up to 5 minutes stale.
No path/query params; GET only.
FREE endpoint — returns 200 on an unpaid request (no x402 charge).
